title: Ticket 1.62 — selected staff food-order report and ticket-domain separation
notes: Adds a manager-only, employee-selectable Excel report of active food orders for a Jalali date range and meal. Enforces support_manager/support staff IT-vs-support ticket scoping in SQL lists and ticket detail/action authorization. No schema migration or online dependency. Emergency order window is located in Food Management > Food Program > select a calendar date and meal > ‘مهلت استثنایی ثبت سفارش’ below the day schedule.
